description:
Health.md for Mac is the free companion to Health.md on iPhone.

Bring selected Apple Health exports to a folder on your Mac, including an Obsidian vault. Your iPhone reads HealthKit; the Mac receives the selected data and writes Markdown, CSV, JSON, or Obsidian Bases files.

HOW TO USE IT
• Open Health.md on both devices.
• Choose and authorize a destination folder on the Mac.
• On iPhone, choose Mac Destination in Sync, select your metrics, date, and formats, then export.

Keep both apps open and connected during transfer. The Mac cannot read Apple Health on its own and does not import Apple's export.xml archive.

ACCESS
The Mac companion remains free. The paired iPhone or iPad requires active trial, subscription, Lifetime, or preserved permanent access. Eligible Apple subscriptions include a seven-day free trial. Family Sharing shares access, not health records.

PRIVACY
This version removes custom app usage analytics and advertising attribution. Exports go to destinations you choose. Essential connections and earlier retained service records are described in the Privacy Policy.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://healthmd.app/privacy-policy.html
whatsNew: Health.md 3.5.0 keeps the Mac companion free and updates privacy wording for the current iPhone and iPad release. Custom app usage analytics and advertising attribution have been removed.
